reason: The plugin is a DSH bundle that enriches agent sessions by loading local OpenClaw persona files into system prompt sections and runtime contexts, with optional workspace/config controls and automatic cache refresh on file changes, so its primary user-facing purpose is memory/context provisioning for agents rather than content creation or external automation.

summaries.zh: 此插件是一个 DSH 配置包，在工作区存在指定 persona 目录时自动读取 OpenClaw 风格文件并将其注入到每个会话中的代理系统提示与运行时上下文。
summaries.en: This plugin is a DSH bundle that automatically reads OpenClaw-style files from a workspace directory and injects them into each agent session's system prompt and runtime context.

capabilities: Loads OpenClaw-style Markdown persona files from workspace directories into agent system and runtime contexts.
Supports auto-injection for each agent session with per-agent cache refresh when relevant local files are changed.
Allows workspace subdirectory and note-handling limits to be configured by environment/packaged settings.

reasons.code: Plugin behavior is described as reading SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, USER.md, TOOLS.md, MEMORY.md, HEARTBEAT.md, AGENTS.md, and memory/*.md from an openclaw-style folder and injecting them into prompt sections/contexts.
DSH bundle configuration is declared in package metadata (`dsh` field) and documented as a host-scoped Cordis plugin that hooks agent lifecycle and tool-result events.
No network, API, or external service integrations are described; interaction is scoped to local workspace files.
